headline: No public smart contract repo, no audit, and no deployed contract addresses discoverable — Sentora is a risk-curator service with no verifiable on-chain artefacts of its own
short_headline: No repo, no audit, no verified contracts

findings.text: No deployed contract addresses were discovered in any fetched source (website, platform pages, vaults app, DeFiLlama). The address_book is null and no addresses appeared in sentora.com, vaults.sentora.com, or any search result. On-chain verification check cannot be performed without addresses. Sentora acts as a curator on top of third-party protocols (Morpho, Euler, Aave) — no proprietary contract addresses are publicly listed.

No public GitHub repository is linked or discoverable. The per-protocol context records github as '(none recorded)'. Multiple fetches of sentora.com, platform subpages, and search results returned no GitHub URL. Source-to-repo correspondence cannot be assessed.

No audit links are recorded in protocol.audit_links. No audit report was found in any fetched source. Third-party reporting (CryptoSlate/CryptoRank, May 2025) explicitly notes 'Questions also persist regarding audit status and smart contract insurance coverage.' No recognized-firm audit has been identified.
No auditor can be identified because no audit report was found. Audit coverage is zero.
Post-audit drift cannot be assessed — no audit baseline exists and no public source repo was found.
No proxy or implementation contracts were identified. No addresses discovered.

steelman.red: Sentora has no public GitHub, no audit links, and no discoverable deployed contract addresses of its own — all three red-grade conditions are simultaneously satisfied.
steelman.orange: Sentora curates vaults on fully audited, verified third-party protocols (Morpho, Euler, Aave) whose smart contracts are publicly verified; the risk to users is primarily through off-chain curator decisions rather than unverified proprietary contracts.
steelman.green: If Sentora's internal smart contract work (referenced as a service on its website) has been audited but not yet made public, the verifiability posture could improve substantially once those artefacts are disclosed.

rationale.verdict: Choosing red because all three primary red-grade conditions are simultaneously met: (1) no public source repo exists or was discoverable (V2), (2) no audit appears in protocol.audit_links and none was found in any fetched source (V3), and (3) no proprietary contract addresses are publicly listed so bytecode verification cannot be confirmed (V1). The orange steelman — that Sentora piggybacks on verified third-party contracts — does not change the verifiability grade for Sentora's own artefacts, which remain entirely opaque.

evidence.shows: Sentora website confirmed fetchable. No GitHub link, no audit disclosures, no deployed contract addresses listed. Platform described as non-custodial vault curation and risk management service on top of third-party DeFi protocols.
Platform strategy page confirms non-custodial vault approach on third-party protocols (Morpho, Euler, Aave referenced elsewhere); no Sentora-owned contract addresses, no GitHub, no audit references.
Smart Yield vaults app returns minimal metadata only (JavaScript app); no contract addresses or GitHub links surfaced.
DeFiLlama lists Sentora as category Risk Curators on Ethereum and Solana; no contract addresses, no audit links, no GitHub in the snippet.

Third-party reporting (May 2025) notes 'Questions also persist regarding audit status and smart contract insurance coverage' and that 'details on supported protocols and custody solutions have yet to be disclosed' — corroborating absence of public audits.

unknowns: V1: No deployed contract addresses discoverable for Sentora on Ethereum or Solana — block-explorer verification could not be attempted; addresses may exist but are not publicly listed on the website or in any fetched source
V2: No public GitHub repository found for Sentora or its predecessor entities (IntoTheBlock, Trident Digital) under the Sentora brand — source-to-repo match impossible
V3: No audit report URL found in protocol.audit_links or any fetched source — audit coverage is unknown; Sentora may have conducted private audits not yet disclosed
V4: Auditor identity unknown — no audit found
V5: Post-audit drift cannot be assessed without an audit baseline or source repo
V6: No proxy/implementation split determinable — no contract addresses found
V1-offchain: On-chain fetch (defipunkd.com read API) not attempted because no contract addresses were discoverable from any fetched source

protocol_metadata.about: Sentora is an institutional DeFi platform formed from the May 2025 merger of IntoTheBlock and Trident Digital, backed by $25 million in Series A funding. It acts as a risk curator and strategy manager, deploying capital across third-party DeFi protocols such as Morpho, Euler, and Aave via non-custodial vaults. Users deposit assets into curated vault strategies that Sentora configures and monitors using over 1,000 risk models, earning yield while Sentora manages protocol selection, collateral parameters, and real-time risk controls. The platform also offers advisory, structured lending, and tokenized-equity yield products for institutional clients.
